name: Table 2-30: Artefact Origin
_doc: Roll once per artefact to determine its origin. Each origin selects a downstream cascade: Finely Wrought -> Skilled Craftsmanship; Ancient Miracle -> Archeotech (Miracles of the Dark Age); Alien Technology -> Xenos Tech (Xenos Construction); Cursed Artefact -> Twisted Omens (Mark of the Curse).
